name: Alex Knob Track
region: Westland Tai Poutini National Park, West Coast
why: The best view of Franz Josef Glacier without a helicopter: a long climb from rainforest through alpine meadows to a 1,303 m knob above the ice.
book: Free walk; DOC charges for parking at the Alex Knob/Lake Wombat car park, 2 km up the Glacier Access Road from the Waiho bridge (cards only). If full, park at the glacier car park and walk back.
water: No water sources on the track: carry all you need.
dangers: Afternoon cloud often hides the glacier in summer: start early.
Steep and long; snow is likely above Christmas Lookout in winter.
West Coast weather changes fast: carry warm and waterproof layers.
turnaround: If cloud is down on the hills at Christmas Lookout or you are not there by 11:00, take the view there and go back.

points.name: Alex Knob / Lake Wombat car park
points.note: On the right of the Glacier Access Road. The track climbs steadily through rimu, rātā and kāmahi forest.

points.name: Lake Wombat turn-off
points.note: A short side track leads to Lake Wombat in the forest.

points.name: Rata Lookout
points.note: About 2 h up: the first glimpses of the glacier through the trees.

points.name: Christmas Lookout
points.note: An hour further at an easier grade: a rest spot with a full view of the glacier on a clear day.

points.name: Alex Knob summit
points.note: 1,303 m, through subalpine scrub and herb fields: glaciers, peaks and the Tasman Sea. Kea may be about. Return the same way.
